corpus.title: Database backup
corpus.text: Create an encrypted database backup snapshot every day. Keep a copy outside the application host. A backup is useful only after a successful restore rehearsal.

corpus.title: Restore verification
corpus.text: Restore the database backup into a disposable database. Run integrity checks and compare row counts before releasing the snapshot. Record the verification outcome.

corpus.title: Webhook retry policy
corpus.text: Retry webhook delivery after a transient 503 response using exponential backoff. Store the attempt count and next retry time. Check for duplicate delivery before creating an order.

corpus.title: Duplicate webhook handling
corpus.text: Store each webhook event identifier with a unique idempotency key. Ignore duplicate events before retry delivery; a replay must not create a second order.

corpus.title: Staff access
corpus.text: Managers can open admin pages. Cashiers may view assigned branches. A signed staff token includes role and branch. This defines which personnel have elevated workspace access.

corpus.title: Pickup windows
corpus.text: Each food box has a pickup window at its branch. Show the start and end time before reservation. An uncollected box expires after the pickup window closes.

corpus.title: Refund requests
corpus.text: A customer refund request needs an order identifier and review by a manager. This handbook describes manual refunds for card purchases only. It contains no cryptocurrency purchase or refund procedure.

corpus.title: Lexical retrieval
corpus.text: A lexical retrieval index uses exact normalized tokens. Search scores describe word overlap; they do not verify generated answers. Answer correctness requires a separate evaluation.
